name: Run Code
description: Run a Python or bash script in this workspace's Linux sandbox and return its output: arithmetic, data, files, charts, anything you'd otherwise estimate. It runs in /work (this chat's scratch); files attached in this chat are in /work/attachments (as text): read them there rather than pasting them into the script; /project keeps files; /public is live web pages, and the reply lists the pages a run changed. numpy, pandas, matplotlib, requests and zola are installed; pip installs persist; the network reaches PyPI only (sandbox-access shows more). For anything over a few minutes, run it in the background and check on it with its run_id. Use bash to list, read, move and delete files.
author: anything

examples.prompt: What's 17% compound interest on 2,400 over 9 years, year by year?
What files do we have for this project?

timeout.description: Seconds before it's killed: default 60, at most 300; in a workspace with heavy runs on (sandbox-access) up to 7200, and a run over 300 gets 3 CPUs and 4 GB.

background.description: true to answer with its run_id if it isn't done within about 45 s, instead of waiting, for a long run (transcribing, training, big downloads); the result is kept for a day.

run_id.description: The id of a background run to check on, instead of running anything: its result, or how long it has been going.
